_about: Hand-written rows for the ReelBot dashboard: what the bot may do, decisions waiting on the owner, and Claude's plan. Edited by Claude when these change.

permissions.what: Make and post 3 reels a day (11:00, 13:00, 19:00 IST) straight to Instagram
permissions.detail: You approved fully automatic posting. 29 Nov - 6 Dec: rotating hours for the timing test; no Telegram ping for night posts. A run that starts more than 2 hours late posts nothing.

permissions.what: Pick the tool, hook, format and pace of each reel from past results
permissions.detail: No format or hook style twice in one day.

permissions.what: Use only checked answers in the 11:00 and 19:00 reels
permissions.detail: Each answer is checked against an official source before it goes in the answer bank.

permissions.what: Add a new checked answer to the bank
permissions.detail: Claude verifies the official source; the bot never invents an answer.

permissions.what: Read every reel's numbers from Instagram
permissions.detail: Under 2 days old: every check. 2-7 days: hourly. 7-30 days: daily. Then it stops.

permissions.what: Learn from reels once they have 24 hours of data
permissions.detail: Switch any reel off on this page and it stops counting towards what the bot learns.

permissions.what: Study competitor reels daily and save their formats, hooks and ideas
permissions.detail: What it learns becomes ideas and formats to test; it never copies a reel.

permissions.what: Rewrite its keep / avoid rules from results
permissions.detail: Updated when a new reel gets measured.

permissions.what: Send you a Telegram summary every 3 hours, and an alert if a run fails
Change the visual style, a slot's language, posting times or reels per day
Delete or edit a reel that is already posted
Send DMs, or promise 'comment X and I'll DM the link'
permissions.detail: The account can't send DMs, so reels never promise one.

permissions.what: Show or move your keys and tokens
permissions.detail: They stay in GitHub secrets and are hidden in every log.

decisions.question: Replace the scout's watch list with creators in our own niche?
decisions.why: The scout watches giant brands (Physics Wallah, Technical Guruji). None of the 25 most-viewed reels it has seen is about documents, PDFs or forms, and Instagram won't let the app search hashtags without Meta's review.
decisions.effect: Send Claude 10-20 Instagram handles of document / form / PDF-tips creators you see going viral (Claude can suggest some too). The scout then studies their best reels daily.

decisions.question: Use the scout's best ideas in the Hinglish reels, not only the 1 pm English one?
decisions.why: Our two best bot reels (1,281 and 1,004 views in 24h, 18 Nov) were scout ideas made as Hinglish 3D stories. Since 19 Nov scout ideas only go into the 1 pm English reel (112-129 views).
decisions.effect: The 7 pm reel alternates: a checked answer one day, the scout's top niche idea the next.

decisions.question: Switch the 1 pm reel from English to Hinglish?
decisions.why: The 1 pm English reel came last every day (112-143 views). Every top reel is Hinglish.

decisions.question: Pick checked answers by results instead of strict rotation?
decisions.why: Strict rotation brings back the HDFC answer next (140 views, 2.2 s watched) while the Aadhaar answers lead.
decisions.effect: Answers with more views, saves and watch time come up more often; weak ones rest.

decisions.question: Set up a free outside timer so every job runs on time?
decisions.why: GitHub's own timer started the stats read 5 times in the last day instead of 288. Reels only go out on time because Claude's checks start them.
decisions.effect: Needs you for 5 minutes: a free cron-job.org account and a GitHub token with Actions access.

decisions.question: Keep the current OmniVoice voice, or move to a voice licensed for business use?
decisions.why: OmniVoice's licence is non-commercial (CC-BY-NC); the page promotes a business.
decisions.effect: Claude would test a commercial-safe voice and show you samples before anything changes.

strategy.why: Your call on 28 Nov. Still 3 reels a day, but at rotating hours (1:30, 4:30, 7:30, 10:30 am, 1:30, 4:30, 7:30, 10:30 pm IST): each hour gets 3 reels (2 Hinglish, 1 English). On 7 Dec we compare first-24h views, watch time, shares and saves per hour and keep the best 3.

strategy.move: Point the scout at real niche competitors
strategy.why: It has studied 78 reels, but from accounts whose views come from celebrity audiences, not from document tips we can learn from.

strategy.move: Open the checked-answer reels by knocking down the wrong guess
strategy.why: Same Aadhaar answer: 601 views with 'Aadhaar number nahi hota', 145-184 as a question.

strategy.move: Keep the 11 am and 7 pm reels on real document questions with checked answers
strategy.why: Aadhaar and PAN questions with an answer get the shares and saves; reels without a real answer got about 3.5 s watched.

strategy.move: Every reel is a funny 3D cartoon story with our own cast (Pappu, Sharma Uncle, Chinki) and Docu, the ilovedocuments.ai mascot
strategy.why: Your call on 28 Nov. 3D stories averaged 910 views in 24h; flat explainers 186. Docu, a PDF page with a heart and the site's name, pops in at the answer and the end of every reel so people remember the page.

strategy.move: Move the 1 pm reel to Hinglish
strategy.why: English 1 pm reels came last every day.

strategy.move: Favour the answers that perform, rest the weak ones
strategy.why: e-Aadhaar validity (358 views, 7.4 s) and Aadhaar password lead; HDFC trails.

strategy.move: Grow the answer bank from 5 to about 15 checked answers
strategy.why: 5 answers repeat within 2-3 days. Candidates: DigiLocker document validity, exam-form photo and signature size limits, PAN-Aadhaar link check. Each checked against an official source first.

strategy.move: Try the competitors' newest formats in the 1 pm test slot
strategy.why: This week the scout picked up 'bad news, share this' alerts and 'one claim, three proofs' from the best niche reels it studied.

strategy.move: Fix the timer so stats are read every 5 minutes
strategy.why: Right now rising reels are spotted hours late.
